# Inset text

**Status:** Stable  
**Reviewed against:** GOV.UK Frontend 6.5.0 on 2026-09-09

Use inset text to distinguish a short block of supporting information from the content around it.

## When to use

- Use for important supplementary information that users should notice but that is not a warning or success state.
- Use for a short block that benefits from visual separation within the flow of the page.

## When not to use

- Do not use for warnings about serious consequences; use Warning text.
- Do not use for successful completion; use a Panel where appropriate.
- Do not place most of a page inside inset text.

## Anatomy

- **Inset container (required):** A govuk-inset-text container provides the reviewed left border and spacing.
- **Supporting content (required):** Concise text or simple semantic content explains the supporting point.

## Variants

| Variant | Element | Classes | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Default | `div` | `govuk-inset-text` | A short supporting block on the standard page background. |

## Behaviour and progressive enhancement

- The component has no JavaScript behaviour and remains ordinary document content without CSS.
- Keep it in the reading order at the point where its information is relevant.

## Accessibility contract

- The left border is decorative; the wording must carry the full meaning.
- Add semantic headings, lists or links inside only when the content requires them.
- Do not use colour or placement alone to indicate urgency.

## Content rules

- Keep the message concise and directly related to the surrounding task.
- Use ordinary sentence case and avoid a heading unless it helps users scan a longer inset.

## Token references

- `govuk.color.border`
- `govuk.color.text`
- `govuk.border.standard`
- `govuk.spacing.static.3`

## HTML examples

### Processing-time information

```html
<div class="govuk-inset-text">
  It can take up to 8 weeks to register a lasting power of attorney.
</div>
```
